changelog:
Initial international release for FTO-screening report skill.

- Converts a supplied risk-point Word document and user-approved PatSnap search expressions into a structured FTO screening report.
- Supports feature extraction, patent retrieval, claim-data collection, structured claim-limitation comparison, risk triage, and HTML/DOCX reporting.
- Handles both PatSnap REST API and MCP connector workflows, with strict provenance and data normalization.
- Does not generate legal opinions or guarantees; clearly defines analytical boundaries and required source materials.
- Preserves user query integrity—no silent changes or assumptions to search expressions.
summary: Create a traceable, screening-level freedom-to-operate report from a supplied risk-point Word document and user-approved PatSnap search expressions. Use when a patent analyst, IP team, product counsel, or R&D owner needs structured feature extraction, PatSnap patent retrieval, claim-data collection, claim-limitation comparison, candidate risk triage, HTML/DOCX reporting, and evidence JSON. Supports a bundled global PatSnap REST workflow or normalized evidence from verified PatSnap MCP connectors. The output is an FTO screening, not a legal clearance opinion.
